description: Imports SVG markup (shapes, transforms, a viewBox, presentation attributes, style rules and declarations, fill and stroke opacity, linear and radial gradients through href chains, blend modes, hidden elements), exports it, adds a live boolean, reads its own export back with replace, and imports clip paths and masks as mask groups. Compares documents, render data and the SVG.
